WITH matched_orders AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) as side_count
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(side_count) as avg_side_count
  FROM matched_orders
)
SELECT 
  SUM(mo.side_count) as total_counts,
  AVG(mo.side_count - ac.avg_side_count) as avg_excess
FROM matched_orders mo
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE mo.side_count > ac.avg_side_count
